name: Leleka-100

placement_rationale.text: The 4 km mark represents the Leleka-100 crew's launch/control site, not the ~100 km airframe range or the ~45 km video/radio link this asset's own characteristics report — those figures describe what the airframe can physically do once airborne, not how close the ground crew stations itself. At 4 km the crew sits inside doctrine.md §2's close-reconnaissance band (1–5 km), the 'second line' activated within seconds of a detection, matching this asset's own employment_notes on that exact role. The system's own 1–5 km operating_range_km envelope independently confirms the same band.

cost.display: ~$240K per airframe (a two-drone + ground-station complex runs ~$480K)

short_role: Catapult-launched fixed-wing ISR drone that finds and confirms targets for artillery and strike drones close to the line.
characteristics: Cruise ~70 km/h, up to ~140 km/h, ceiling ~1,500 m
Day/night video module streams live to a ground control station
employment_notes: Operates as the 'second line' of close reconnaissance — activated within seconds of a detection to confirm and refine a target before handing off coordinates to a howitzer or a strike drone. Crews displace frequently: a drone's return flight path and landing point are exactly what an enemy team watches for, so the same pattern-of-life discipline that finds enemy positions applies to this crew too.
contrast_vs_traditional: Traditional reconnaissance meant scouts or a manned aircraft reporting up a chain that took hours to act on. A tactical recon drone like this closes that to single-digit minutes when paired directly with a firing asset, and it operates inside the close-reconnaissance band — roughly 1–5 km — that gets activated almost as soon as something is detected. The tradeoff: the crew is now huntable by the exact same 'follow it home' pattern-of-life method it uses against the other side.

reactive_behavior.description: On select: drone launches, orbits a point, streams a target marker back to the ground station.

connections.description: Relays video/telemetry over satellite comms when terrestrial links are jammed or unavailable.
